root_cause: In gemm8x8x32_bias_relu_top/input_loader interaction, start_load is asserted only after CMD handshake in ST_IDLE, but input_loader transitions to L_A on that same edge and only accepts A beats afterward. The CMD beat is not handled by loader, causing section misalignment/deadlock (no progress signals ever assert).

first_divergence.expected: After command, loader should accept exactly 256 A beats then progress to B/BIAS and eventually assert load_done.
first_divergence.observed: Diagnostic trace near timeout shows state=IDLE, s_ready=0, start_* all 0, load_done/compute_done/post_done/out_done all 0; no job progress in any test.

evidence.observation: Primary run times out at first test start (SIMULATION_TIMEOUT).
evidence.relevance: Establishes authoritative fatal stage is functional simulation timeout.

evidence.observation: All 4 tests fail by bounded timeout; sampled signals show no FSM/submodule progress and no handshake-ready activity at observed stalled point.
evidence.relevance: Confirms systemic deadlock/progress failure, not isolated arithmetic mismatch.

evidence.observation: cmd_hs_idle requires IDLE+s_valid+s_ready+s_type==CMD; on that handshake top pulses start_load and leaves IDLE.
evidence.relevance: Top consumes CMD before loader is active.

evidence.observation: start_load moves loader to L_A; loader only consumes A/B/BIAS payloads and has no CMD state.
evidence.relevance: Interface mismatch explains dropped/misaligned first beat and non-termination.

alternative_hypotheses: Secondary width warnings cause functional corruption (unlikely: non-fatal and not timeout root).
Compute/post/output internal pipeline bug independent of loader (less consistent with zero progress across all tests).
